definitions.explanation: The process of learning and refining a skill through repeated practice. Emphasizes sustained, disciplined effort over time.

examples.japanese: {技術|ぎじゅつ}の{習練|しゅうれん}を{積|つ}む。
examples.english: To accumulate practice in a skill.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{習練|しゅうれん}で{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}いた。
examples.english: I honed my skills through years of practice.

examples.japanese: {新人|しんじん}は{基本的|きほんてき}な{習練|しゅうれん}を{終|お}えてから{現場|げんば}に{出|で}る。
examples.english: New employees go to the field after completing basic training.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word emphasizing the learning aspect of practice. The verb form is {習練|しゅうれん}する. More literary than {練習|れんしゅう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {習練|しゅうれん}を{積|つ}む (to accumulate training)
- {習練|しゅうれん}を{重|かさ}ねる (to undergo repeated training)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {練習|れんしゅう}: practice — more common and general
- {修行|しゅぎょう}: ascetic training, apprenticeship — has spiritual or traditional connotations
- {訓練|くんれん}: training, drill — more structured, often military or professional
